paragraphs.text:
Whatever you do, it incites the sasquatches. They seize you, 
Sylvia, and Norman, and drag you all away into the hills.

Before  long,  you  reach  their  encampment.  They  seem 
ignorant of any art or craft, including fire. There are traces of 
skins and feathers, the remains of former meals, but otherwise, 
it could be a rest stop for a family of gorillas.

Your captors shove you under a rock overhang and post a couple 
of large males outside as guards. As you assess the situation, you 
begin to wish you had taken to your heels with Bernard.
